title: eduroam Access Point
description: Everything the probe knows about one access point.

list.name: ap
list.label: Access point
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "eduroam", tag: "ap_name", start: -90d, predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan" and r.ssid == "eduroam")

list.name: chan
list.query:
from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan" and r._field == "signal_dbm" and r.ap_name == "${ap}")
  |> keep(columns: ["channel"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "channel")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_test" and exists r.bssid)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["success", "fail_reason", "scan_signal_dbm", "channel_util_pct", "station_count", "l2_total_ms", "eap_ms", "dhcp_ms", "gw_rtt_avg_ms", "gw_loss_pct", "inet_loss_pct", "dns1_ms", "http_total_ms"]))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["bssid"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["success", "band", "channel", "fail_stage", "fail_reason", "scan_signal_dbm", "channel_util_pct", "station_count", "l2_total_ms", "eap_ms", "dhcp_ms", "gw_rtt_avg_ms", "gw_loss_pct", "dns1_ms", "http_total_ms", "bssid", "_time"])
  |> sort(columns: ["band"])

from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal_dbm")
  |> group(columns: ["band"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "channel_util_pct")
  |> group(columns: ["band"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "station_count")
  |> group(columns: ["band"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()

from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_test" and r._field == "l2_total_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["band"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Link quality (retries, failures, beacon loss)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_test")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["tx_retries", "tx_failed", "beacon_loss"]))
  |> group(columns: ["band", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.description: High retries or beacon loss point to interference or a struggling radio.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ap_name =~ /^${ap:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["signal_dbm", "channel_util_pct"]))
  |> group(columns: ["band", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Other networks on this AP's channel(s) (latest)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eduroam")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "wifi_scan" and exists r.bssid)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel =~ /^${chan:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["signal_dbm", "channel_util_pct", "station_count"]))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["bssid"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["ssid", "ap_name", "band", "channel", "signal_dbm", "channel_util_pct", "station_count", "bssid"])
  |> sort(columns: ["signal_dbm"], desc: true)

  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "success", "band", "fail_stage", "fail_reason", "scan_signal_dbm", "l2_total_ms", "eap_ms", "handshake_ms", "dhcp_ms", "gw_rtt_avg_ms", "gw_loss_pct", "inet_loss_pct", "dns1_ms", "http_total_ms", "tx_bitrate_mbps", "location"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
